items.summary:
Season 2 of The Hunting Wives killed off so many people — and yet the show also found a way to bring some back from the dead. 

In the newest installment, which started streaming on Thursday, November 26, Starr ( Chrissy Metz ) and Jill ( Katie Lowes ) were featured in flashback scenes and dream flashback sequences , which came as a surprise to the audience and the cast.

“It’s important and I love a backstory and I love a flashback,” Metz, 46, exclusively told Us about showing the days leading up to Starr’s attempt to avenge her daughter’s death in season 1. “I didn’t know that they would be bringing Starr back for the second season.”

Metz could see the potential for more appearances, adding, “There’s a lot to uncover and discover with her. I do want to know more of her motivation and I do think that there’s history with all the hunting wives. She used to be a part of the group and she’s not so much anymore. We all know what it’s like to not be involved in a group or clique or the mom group … not that she wants to be involved because those ladies are terrible. They’re bad. She prays for them.”

'Hunting Wives' Season 2 Has a Shocking Onscreen Death After Book Changes 

Looking ahead, Metz hinted at more mysteries surrounding Starr and Jill that needed to be solved.

“To keep anything going is a miracle. So that’s really great [that they were renewed for season 3],” she shared. “But it was great to be back for a little bit. I wish there was more because I think there is so much more and people really took to Starr because she was so different from the other women.”…

The Hell’s Kitchen host and his wife, Tana Ramsay , have built one of Hollywood’s most recognizable families over nearly three decades of marriage as the celebrity chef has continued to host cooking shows and competitions across the country.

The pair, who wed in December 1996, share six children: Megan, twins Holly and Jack, Matilda “Tilly”, Oscar and Jesse.

Here’s everything to know about the ever-expanding Ramsay brigade:

Gordon Ramsay Was a 'Hot Mess' While Giving Speech at Daughter's Wedding 

Gordon Ramsay and Tana Ramsay’s Love Story 
 Gordon and Tana met in the early 1990s and tied the knot in December 1996. Tana, a cookbook author, has been a steady presence beside her famous husband, raising their kids largely out of the spotlight while quietly building her own brand.

The couple has also been candid about the heartbreak that shaped their family. In June 2016, Tana suffered a miscarriage.

“Hi guys, Tana and I want to thank you so much for your support over the past couple of weeks,” Gordon wrote on Facebook at the time. “We had a devastating weekend as Tana has sadly miscarried our son at five months. We’re together healing as a family, but we want to thank everyone again for all your amazing support and well wishes.”

items.title: Jana Kramer Opens Up About the Pain of Splitting the Holidays After Divorce
items.summary:
Jana Kramer is reminding divorced parents that it’s OK to feel a variety of emotions as they navigate the holidays with or without their kids.

“I think it’s hard because no matter what, it’s not normal for a mom to wake up on Christmas and not have their kids,” Kramer, 42, exclusively shared with Us before the release of her new Lifetime holiday movie, Love on the Christmas List . “This is the year that I don’t get to see my kids on Christmas morning, and I don’t know which is worse. I don’t know whether it’s worse to not have them in the morning or to say bye to them on Christmas Day.”

Kramer shares daughter Jolie, 10, and son Jace, 7, with ex-husband Mike Caussin . She also welcomed son Roman in November 2023 with husband Allan Russell .

“Last year was the first year that I didn’t have a full, complete meltdown. I just kind of had a little cry,” Kramer continued. “I don’t beat myself up for that anymore because I just think about how it’s not supposed to be a normal thing. I’m a mom who wants her kids every day, and I want to wake up to them running down the stairs on Christmas morning. And this year, I don’t get that.”

Jana Kramer’s Best Quotes About Coparenting With Mike Caussin 

The former One Tree Hill actress finds comfort in knowing her two oldest kids have a nice time at Caussin’s house. As many parents can relate to, however, Kramer wishes her time wasn’t cut short.

items.title: Brooke Hogan Reflects on Grief Before Thanksgiving Without Dad Hulk Hogan
items.summary:
The Thanksgiving holiday is allowing Brooke Hogan to reflect on the loss of her father, wrestling icon Hulk Hogan .

“I’ve realized that so much of my grief exists in what we will miss together, rather than even what we’ve lost…,” Brooke, 38, wrote via Instagram on Wednesday, November 25. “It’s a strange thing. Nostalgia in reverse. Longing for moments somewhere in the future that feel almost as familiar as memories.”

The founder of BB Designs by Brooke continued, “I miss him in the thought of him falling asleep on my couch, after too much pecan pie, surrounded by the beautiful little family that is an extension of his own. I imagine the evolution of our relationship as I grow older.”

Hulk died in July 2025 at the age of 71. His cause of death was acute myocardial infarction, most commonly known as a heart attack, according to documents obtained by Us .

Brooke Hogan Reacts to Speculation She Loves 'Spotlight' After Hulk’s Death 

Although her relationship with Hulk was complicated, Brooke — who shared a throwback photo with her father for her latest post — has been open about her grieving journey and processing different emotions.

“Sometimes the circumstances surrounding a relationship don’t accurately reflect the love that exists within it,” she wrote. “Life and dishonest influence can create distance between two hearts that were never meant to be far apart. I’ll die on that hill. No daughter doesn’t want her daddy.”

“How strange it is to miss someone in a place you’ve yet to visit, at an age you’ve yet to reach, in a moment that’s still somewhere in your future,”…
items.t: Brooke Hogan Reflects on Grief Before Thanksgiving Without Dad Hulk Hogan

“This year, I said I wanted to make the turkey, which is not always the case,” Williamson, 48, exclusively shared with Us while discussing her recent partnership with luxury appliance brand Thermador . “We’re doing an Italian theme this year, and Bobby always does a themed Thanksgiving. Last year, we did Southeast Asian Thanksgiving, and everything had Southeast Asian flavors.”

She continued, “I think that having a theme makes it kind of creative and fun, and turns those traditional dishes into something slightly more unexpected.”

According to Williamson, Flay, 61, loves mashed potatoes while she savors stuffing and makes sure the traditional dish is on the table in November.

How Chefs Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson Split Culinary Duties at Home 

“I think we’re both really flexible,” she said. “But if I want to make a squash dish, then I do feel like some greens and some vegetables are necessary. Bobby’s more of a starch and protein kind of person, so I will probably add a couple of extra veggies to the table.”

While Williamson joked that her boyfriend wakes up hungry every day, Thanksgiving is extra special for the pair as they both love food and creating special memories in the kitchen.

“Thanksgiving is the ultimate sort of fall, winter holiday in the sense that it’s all about the food. It’s about the family, but there’s less pressure than, like, say, Christmas or Hanukkah with gifts,” she said. “It’s about the food.…
items.t: Brooke Williamson Previews Her Delicious Thanksgiving Feast With Bobby Flay

items.title: Luke Wilson Teases ‘The Family Stone’ Sequel, Reuniting With Cast Members
items.summary:
Luke Wilson reflected on the legacy of The Family Stone in the midst of shooting next year’s highly-anticipated sequel .  

“I feel like I’ve just kind of been in a bubble making it here for the last month,” Wilson, 55, exclusively told Us via his partnership with Fanatics. “It was one of those movies where, you know, it was really fun to make the first one. A great group of people. It came out and people seemed to like it. But then it was a few years later, I’d start to hear things like, ‘Oh my family and I watch that every Thanksgiving,’ or ‘My family and I watch that every Christmas.’ Each year it seemed like more.” 

The actor added, “I’m so used to Chevy Chase and Christmas Vacation or It’s a Wonderful Life . So when people started to say their families were watching The Family Stone , I said, ‘Really?’ But now it does seem like it’s become a genuine tradition for people.” 

The Family Stone was released in 2005, featuring an ensemble cast including Rachel McAdams , Dermot Mulroney , Sarah Jessica Parker , Claire Danes , Craig T. Nelson and the late Diane Keaton . A sequel was announced in September with all of the original cast set to return, plus the addition of 9-time Emmy winner, Jean Smart .  

Aaron Rodgers Goes Scorched Earth on 'Unwell' Mike McCarthy After Benching 

“I’m wary of saying anything about the damn plot because I feel like I’d have the studio come down on my head,” Wilson joked. “I’ll just say people get together, people split apart, babies are born. It revolves around Christmas again and I think it comes out in November of next year.”

items.title: Which 'Hunting Wives' Stars Are, Aren't Returning for Season 3 After Deaths?
items.summary:
The Hunting Wives has been renewed for season 3 — but fans might not see every cast member returning to the show. 

Based on May Cobb ‘s book of the same name, The Hunting Wives introduced Sophie ( Brittany Snow ), who found herself drawn to prominent socialite Margo ( Malin Åkerman ) after moving from Boston to an East Texas town. While some became invested in the murder at the center of the series, the show’s first season also provided plenty of entertainment with guns, drinking and steamy onscreen hookups.

Despite the obstacles facing Sophie and Margo , Åkerman hasn’t given up hope on the pair’s future. “They find a way,” she told Us in November 2026 ahead of the season 2 premiere. “They come together and they break apart. It’s the epic, toxic love story that we all adore, so that’s really up to [creator] Rebecca [Cutter] to decide how they eventually, by season 13, run off together and live happily ever after.”

Åkerman jokingly agreed that things would be easier for them with some men out of the way.

Biggest Differences Between Netflix's ‘The Hunting Wives’ Show and the Book 

“I agree [that we need to get rid of the men]. We need to because we need to get them out of the way so Sophie and Margo can be together forever,” she said. “And [Margo’s husband] Jed is standing in the way right now. But it’d be tricky.”

Cutter also spoke to Us about the odds of a happy ending for the couple, saying, “Sophie obviously is the eyes through which we see the show. When she came in, she wasn’t ready for a Margo Banks. She wanted it, but she was in a weakened place in her life.”…

items.title: Jenny McCarthy Details $6K Mold Treatment Amid Her 2-Year Health Struggles
items.summary:
Jenny McCarthy is sharing a candid update amid her challenging mold poisoning recovery .

According to People , McCarthy, 54, shared the latest on her health ordeal via Instagram Live on Tuesday, November 24. In the social media live broadcast, the Masked Singer judge underwent another round of a therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) treatment, which costs $6k per session.

McCarthy reportedly said it was her fifth and final round of the treatment after undergoing the sessions once a month.

“Unfortunately, the typical mold detox that most people do didn’t work for me. It was really frustrating,” she said. “I was spending so much money on s**t that wasn’t working.”

Jenny McCarthy Worried Husband Donnie Wahlberg With 'Breakdown' Over Mold 

According to McCarthy, the TV personality suffered a range of symptoms due to mold poisoning. These included weight gain, eye swelling, chalazions, fibromyalgia among others.

McCarthy said the TPE sessions have dramatically improved her condition.

“I feel so much better,” she said. “I feel like the life is back inside of me. I feel like I’m not as sensitive to the world. I’m not living out of a tent anymore. I was so chemically sensitive that I couldn’t handle much so I know that I’m getting better because I’m not as sensitive.”

Jenny McCarthy. (Photo by Phillip Faraone/Getty Images for iHeartRadio) 
 In the October 28 episode of her podcast, “The Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg Show,” the former Playboy model shared eye-opening details of her two-year battle with mold and mycotoxin poisoning.

items.title: Khloe Kardashian Reveals If She Would Ever Consider a Lavender Marriage
items.summary:
After going through several messy breakups, Khloé Kardashian revealed whether she would explore a lavender marriage.

During the Thursday, November 26, episode of The Kardashians , content creator Colt Paulsen asked Kardashian, 42, at an event whether she would enter a marriage with a gay man, to which she replied, “I’m down.”

Kardashian elaborated about the possibility of being in a platonic partnership in a confessional.

“There’s times [where] yes [I do consider it] and then other times, I’m like … to take care of one more person,” she explained. “I don’t know. It depends on what that gay man can do for me.”

Khloe Kardashian's Candid Quotes About Finding Love After Tristan Scandal 

Kardashian continued: “Will you make me look pretty every day? Sold. That’s all it takes.”

The reality star has previously made headlines for her personal life when she dated former NBA star Lamar Odom for one month before getting engaged in 2009. The pair got married later that year and Kardashian filed for divorce in December 2013 for the first time. Kardashian later postponed her court motion after Odom — who struggled with substance abuse during part of their marriage — was left comatose following an overdose at a legal brothel in Nevada.

“Lamar was and is definitely someone that I felt was the love of my life,” Kardashian said on The Kardashians in a February 2025 episode. “I got married when I was 24 and although him and I got married 30 days to the day we met, I loved him with all of my heart and soul. I took my vows very seriously and I was married for about seven years. But…
